prompt:
Write 8 short claim log entries (one to three sentences each) by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim, in time order. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1343; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
- Nothing suggests the damage happened before the coverage started.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text:
Entry 1: Claim received for a sideswipe that occurred while the insured's vehicle was changing lanes. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.

Entry 2: Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy and that coverage was in force on the date of loss. Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the policy start.

Entry 3: Reviewed the police report and the photos from the scene. Both the officer and the independent witnesses describe the collision as it was reported, and the claimant is confirmed as an occupant of the vehicle.

Entry 4: Inspected the vehicle. Most of the damage lines up with the described impact along the driver's side. A few older scratches are present that may predate this loss, and I have noted them separately for the estimate.

Entry 5: Spoke with the other driver, who gave an account that matches the claimant's description of the lane change. The claimant has told the same account in every conversation so far.

Entry 6: Received medical documentation for a knee injury. The type of injury and the force of the crash are consistent with each other. Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, so I have requested the treatment notes.

Entry 7: The claimant's records show a minor strain in the same area several years ago, which healed fully with no lasting effects. The prior episode has been noted, and I am reviewing it alongside the current treatment.

Entry 8: Liability and vehicle damage are well supported by the evidence. The open items are the length of treatment and the relationship to the prior strain, and both are awaiting records from the treating provider.
